comment: Reference game UIs for markup recreation qualification. Remote images are fetched at test time into a gitignored cache, authenticated against the committed SHA-256/byte/media-type identity, and never redistributed. Thresholds are measured baselines: each recreation must score at or above its threshold or the qualification fails.
